description: The Master of Arts (MA) program in Applied Anthropology offers two tracks: Cultural Anthropology and Public Archeology. The MA program helps students develop skills in grant writing, research design, project management, and cultural resource management. Students can also participate in fieldwork, internships, and laboratory research. The program prepares students for careers in cultural resource management, museums, non-profit agencies, community advocacy organizations, government agencies, international development, and more. A PhD in Applied Anthropology is also available.
Program name: Master of Arts in Applied Anthropology

description: The MA in Art Education allows students to tailor their graduate studies to suit their interests and career goals. Students choose courses from the fields of art education, art history, studio art and related areas. The program offers thesis and non-thesis options. Graduates are prepared for a range of professional opportunities as art educators in K-12 schools, community organizations, museums, galleries and other institutions.
Program name: Master of Arts in Art Education

description: The Master of Arts in Art History degree program offers two paths to completion: a thesis option and a non-thesis option. In both cases, the program is a 30-hour course of study for students interested in advanced work in art history. Students pursuing the M.A. in Art History work closely with faculty in their areas of interest, are involved in research and critical analysis, and have opportunities to develop their teaching skills and gain professional experience. The M.A. prepares students for careers in museums, galleries, and archives, as well as for further graduate study at the doctoral level.
Program name: Master of Arts in Art History

Concentration name: Health Communication, Intercultural Communication, Mediated Communication
description: The Master of Arts in Communication Studies program prepares students for a diverse range of careers in higher education, research, and for positions within private and public organizations. The program allows students to specialize within the areas of Health Communication, Intercultural Communication, and Mediated Communication, while preparing them for doctoral work. The curriculum helps students develop knowledge and skills in critical inquiry, research design, theory, and professional presentation within and beyond the communication discipline. Faculty expertise includes intercultural communication, health communication, rhetorical studies, media studies, organizational communication, and interpersonal communication.
Program name: Master of Arts in Communication Studies

description: The Master of Arts in Creative Writing at UNT provides advanced study in the writing of fiction, poetry, and literary nonfiction. Our program emphasizes work in one primary genre, as well as the study of literature and literary theory, culminating in the composition of a book-length manuscript or thesis. Graduates of our program teach creative writing and English at the high school and college levels, work in editing and publishing, or continue on to Ph.D. programs.
Program name: Master of Arts in Creative Writing

description: The Master of Arts program in English at UNT provides graduate students with a rigorous, comprehensive education in literary studies. Students engage in advanced critical thinking and research, developing expertise in various literary periods, genres, and theoretical approaches. The curriculum emphasizes analytical skills, clear communication, and scholarly writing, preparing graduates for doctoral studies, teaching positions, and diverse professional careers.
Program name: Master of Arts in English

description: The Department of History offers a Master of Arts degree that provides advanced training in historical research and writing. The program prepares students for continued graduate work at the Ph.D. level or for a variety of public and private sector careers, including teaching at the community college level, work in museums, archives, or government agencies. Students select a major field (American History, European History, or Latin American History) and a minor field from a different region (American, European, or Latin American) or from a topical field (African History, Asian History, Ancient/Classical History, or Public History). Students also select a subfield, which may be a specific time period or a particular approach to history (e.g., gender history, environmental history, etc.).
Program name: Master of Arts in History

description:
The MA in Interdisciplinary Studies is a research-based, customizable graduate program that provides students with the opportunity to pursue an individualized course of study. The curriculum is constructed around three academic areas, or fields of study, chosen by the student. These fields of study draw from the rich and diverse faculty and departmental offerings across the university.
The MA in Interdisciplinary Studies is designed for students seeking a graduate program that transcends traditional disciplinary boundaries and fosters critical thinking, problem-solving, and cross-disciplinary communication skills. Graduates are prepared for careers that require adaptability, creativity, and the ability to synthesize knowledge from multiple perspectives.
Students work closely with an Interdisciplinary Studies faculty advisor and a faculty committee chosen by the student, ensuring personalized guidance throughout their academic journey.
Program name: Master of Arts in Interdisciplinary Studies

description: The Interdisciplinary Studies (M.A.) with a concentration in Applied Gerontology combines the expertise of UNT’s Gerontology program with the flexibility of the Interdisciplinary Studies M.A. The program is designed for students interested in working with older adults in a variety of settings, as well as those pursuing further graduate education in gerontology. Coursework is designed to provide students with a strong theoretical and practical understanding of gerontology.
Program name: Master of Arts in Interdisciplinary Studies with a concentration in Applied Gerontology

description: The Master of Arts in Interdisciplinary Studies (MAIS) degree program is designed for students whose intellectual and professional interests require a unique combination of courses from three academic disciplines at UNT. This degree provides flexibility in course selection and research options. Students, with the help of a faculty advisory committee, design a plan of study that crosses departmental, college and institutional boundaries. The MAIS degree allows for flexibility in course selection and research options within areas such as Digital Humanities, Information Science, Music, Public Administration, Public Relations, Rehabilitation Counseling, Sociology, Technical Communication and Urban Planning.
Program name: Master of Arts in Interdisciplinary Studies with a concentration in Digital Social Science

description: The Master of Arts in Interdisciplinary Studies (MAIS) is a custom-designed master's degree program that allows students to combine graduate-level courses from three academic disciplines into a unified program of study based on a central theme, problem or issue. The humanities concentration allows students to pursue courses related to Art, Dance, English, History, Journalism, Media Arts, Music, Philosophy and Religion, Second Language Acquisition, Sociology, and Technical Communication.
Program name: Master of Arts in Interdisciplinary Studies with a concentration in Humanities

description: Our Master of Arts in Interdisciplinary Studies with a concentration in Interactive and Virtual Digital Communication is available in a convenient 100% online format. In this program, you’ll focus on how humans communicate and interact with digital technologies to create virtual experiences. The digital communication concentration helps students understand and critically analyze digital communication and media, as well as design and develop digital interactive and virtual experiences. You'll learn about: Digital communication in society, Communication in digital environments, Virtual environments and experiences, Media and digital communication ethics, Interactive media theory, Research methods in digital communication. UNT offers students the opportunity to: Study with faculty from various departments and colleges across the university. Work with an interdisciplinary team to apply skills in a practical setting. Prepare for a career in interactive and virtual communication, marketing, public relations or digital media.
Program name: Master of Arts in Interdisciplinary Studies with a concentration in Interactive and Virtual Digital Communication

description: UNT's Master of Arts in Interdisciplinary Studies with a concentration in Program Leadership prepares you to lead programs in a variety of settings. Organizations across all sectors (government, non-profit, corporate, educational) need skilled program leaders to plan, manage, evaluate and lead the initiatives that serve their missions. Program leadership is an evolving field that demands individuals with both conceptual and practical skills. In this concentration, you will explore the knowledge and skills necessary to be an effective program leader, including program planning, development, implementation, evaluation, fundraising, strategic planning, human resources, budgeting and assessment. Our unique curriculum allows students to integrate the study of program leadership with another area of interest such as business, communication, higher education, public administration or another field. It is a highly customizable degree that can be tailored to meet your specific career goals. We offer courses fully online.
Program name: Master of Arts in Interdisciplinary Studies with a concentration in Program Leadership

description: The Master of Arts in International Studies (MAIS) program at the University of North Texas provides students with an interdisciplinary understanding of global issues and prepares them for careers in international affairs, government, non-governmental organizations, and further graduate study. Students develop advanced analytical skills, critical thinking, and a comprehensive understanding of international political, economic, and cultural dynamics. The curriculum is designed to offer both breadth in international studies and the opportunity for specialization through elective courses and thesis/professional paper options.
Program name: Master of Arts in International Studies

description: The Master of Arts in Journalism program gives students the opportunity to advance their knowledge and skills to lead and innovate in the ever-evolving fields of media and communication. Students gain expertise in media theory, research, ethics, and practices across a variety of traditional and emerging platforms. Through advanced coursework and scholarly inquiry, students develop a deep understanding of the role of journalism in a democratic society, critical thinking skills, and proficiency in creating high-quality, impactful content. This program is ideal for professionals seeking career advancement, individuals preparing for doctoral studies, or those looking to transition into the dynamic world of journalism and strategic communication. Graduates are prepared for leadership roles in news organizations, public relations, advertising, media management, content creation, and related fields, or for further academic pursuits.
Program name: Master of Arts in Journalism

description: The Master of Arts (MA) in Media Industry and Critical Studies prepares students for further graduate study in media studies or related fields, as well as for work in a variety of industries (including the media industry) that require advanced analytical, communication, and research skills. Drawing upon a critical and interdisciplinary approach, the MA curriculum grounds students in the history, theory, and methods of media studies, while also providing them with knowledge of the shifting landscape of media industries and their cultural, economic, and political significance. Required coursework provides a foundation in media industry and critical studies research. Students then choose electives from a wide range of courses in media theory and history, media industries and institutions, and media and culture. The program provides two options for completing the MA: the thesis option and the professional paper option. In consultation with a graduate advisor, students choose the option best suited to their academic and professional goals.
Program name: Master of Arts in Media Industry and Critical Studies
Master of Arts in Music

description: This program is designed for students whose intellectual interests are best served by broad, rather than highly specialized, study within philosophy. Students will explore traditional areas of philosophy (e.g., epistemology, metaphysics, ethics, logic, history of philosophy) and will gain an awareness of current work in these areas. The program provides a broad-based, rigorous education in philosophy suitable for students who wish to teach philosophy at community colleges, pursue a Ph.D. in philosophy, or obtain an M.A. as preparation for other professional or academic careers.
Program name: Master of Arts in Philosophy

description: The M.A. in Political Science offers students training in the discipline's major fields as well as an opportunity to deepen their understanding of political phenomena. Students can elect to write a thesis or complete a non-thesis option. The program is designed to prepare students for a Ph.D. program or for employment in government, think tanks, or the private sector. Students in the M.A. program take 30 hours of graduate work, including courses in American politics, comparative politics, and international relations, as well as political theory and methodology. All students must complete PSCI 5000: Political Science Research and Methods. At the completion of their coursework, students take comprehensive examinations in two of the three subfields (American politics, comparative politics, or international relations) or submit a thesis.
Program name: Master of Arts in Political Science

description: The Master of Arts in Political Science with a concentration in Advocacy, Politics and Policy is designed to provide students with a strong theoretical and practical understanding of political processes, public policy and advocacy. The program will equip students with the necessary skills to analyze complex political issues, develop effective advocacy strategies, and contribute to public discourse and policymaking. Students will engage with core concepts in political science, including political theory, comparative politics, international relations, and American politics, while also gaining specialized knowledge in areas such as grassroots organizing, lobbying, campaign management, and policy analysis.
Program name: Master of Arts in Political Science with a concentration in Advocacy, Politics and Policy

description: The Master of Arts in Professional and Technical Communication is an interdisciplinary degree that enables students to develop their skills as communicators, researchers, and critical thinkers. Students in the program develop practical and theoretical knowledge that prepares them for careers in fields such as: corporate communications, technical writing, editing, grant writing, digital content creation, information architecture, usability, web design, and digital publication. Students in our program also learn how to engage in ethical and critical communication across various contexts, and they learn how to apply their skills as professional communicators to a variety of workplaces and organizations. Coursework provides students with the opportunity to pursue individualized interests in a range of relevant areas, including: rhetoric, writing and editing, digital media, digital humanities, and communication for social justice.
Program name: Master of Arts in Professional and Technical Communication

description: The M.A. program in Spanish is designed to develop in students a broad knowledge of Hispanic literatures and cultures, as well as an advanced command of the Spanish language. Students may choose either the Latin American literature and cultures option or the Peninsular literature and cultures option. Both options prepare students for doctoral work in Spanish or related fields and for careers requiring expertise in Spanish language, literature and culture. They are particularly relevant for those seeking to teach Spanish at the college or secondary level. The M.A. in Spanish requires 30 credit hours. Students may choose a thesis or non-thesis option.
Program name: Master of Arts in Spanish

description: The M.A. in Women’s and Gender Studies is an interdisciplinary program designed to meet the needs of students interested in the history, theory, and cultural dimensions of women’s lives; gender as a social and cultural construction; feminist theory and methods; and the study of sexuality. The M.A. in Women’s and Gender Studies at UNT aims to prepare students for professional work as well as for further graduate study. It trains students in research skills, including critical and theoretical analysis, qualitative and quantitative methodologies, and the ethical issues involved in humanistic and social scientific scholarship. By emphasizing an interdisciplinary approach, students learn to apply critical thinking and problem-solving skills to issues affecting women and gender in diverse contexts and to translate theory into practice for professional and personal development. The M.A. in Women’s and Gender Studies program will enhance students’ understanding of the historical and cross-cultural constructions of gender and sexuality, enable them to apply feminist theoretical approaches and methodologies to a range of research topics, and prepare them to be successful in a diverse array of professional fields.
Program name: Master of Arts in Women's and Gender Studies
Master of Business Administration (MBA)

description:
Advance your career with an online MBA from the University of North Texas. Our 36-credit online Master of Business Administration with a concentration in Business Analytics gives you the tools to succeed in today’s evolving data economy. The curriculum is designed to help you become a business leader who understands how to apply analytical methods and tools to derive actionable insights from business data.
Upon completion of the MBA in Business Analytics, you will be able to:
* Analyze business problems and formulate solutions by applying a variety of analytics tools and techniques.
* Communicate analytical findings clearly and concisely, orally and in writing, to business professionals.
* Lead business organizations and teams in developing and implementing data analytics strategies.
* Demonstrate awareness of ethical and societal issues related to the use of business analytics.
Accreditation status: The UNT G. Brint Ryan College of Business is accredited by AACSB International – The Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business.
Program name: Master of Business Administration in Business Analytics

Accreditation status: Accredited by the Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB)
Program name: Master of Business Administration in Management Consulting

description: Students in the MBA program develop a strong business foundation and acquire the knowledge and skills necessary to advance into leadership positions within the public and private sector. The UNT MBA combines the traditional rigor of a master of business administration degree with innovative, current business practices focusing on data analytics and critical thinking. The program prepares students to meet the challenges of an evolving global economy with a variety of specialized concentration options to meet individual career goals. This program is offered completely online or in a face-to-face format.
Accreditation status: The UNT G. Brint Ryan College of Business is accredited by AACSB International – The Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business.
Program name: Master of Business Administration in Sport Entertainment Management

description: As a student in the Master of Education in Counseling program, you'll gain the skills and experience necessary to work as a professional counselor in a variety of settings. The program is designed to meet the growing demand for qualified counselors in schools and other organizations. Our Council for the Accreditation of Counseling and Related Educational Programs (CACREP) accredited Master of Education in Counseling program offers the School Counseling specialization. This specialization prepares students to work as school counselors in K-12 settings. In addition, students in the School Counseling program meet the academic requirements for the Licensed Professional Counselor credential in Texas.
Accreditation status: Council for the Accreditation of Counseling and Related Educational Programs (CACREP) accredited
Program name: Master of Education in Counseling
Master of Education in Curriculum and Instruction

description: The Master of Education (M.Ed.) in Educational Leadership degree is designed for students who desire leadership positions in schools, school districts and other educational agencies. The program is committed to preparing high quality school leaders to serve as principals, assistant principals and other administrative positions. The program leads to principal certification if required state examinations are passed and all other certification requirements are met. The program prepares students to meet requirements for Texas principal certification, including the Texas Principal as Instructional Leader certification exam.
Program name: Master of Education in Educational Leadership

description: The Master of Education (M.Ed.) in Higher Education provides students with the knowledge and skills necessary to work in a variety of higher education settings, including colleges and universities. The program prepares students for professional positions in areas such as student affairs, academic advising, admissions, alumni relations, institutional research, and administration. The program also serves as excellent preparation for doctoral studies in higher education.
Program name: Master of Education in Higher Education

Concentration name: High Incidence Disabilities, Low Incidence Disabilities
description: The Master of Education (M.Ed.) in Special Education with a concentration in either high-incidence or low-incidence disabilities prepares educators and related service professionals for advanced leadership positions in settings that serve individuals with disabilities from early childhood through adulthood. Our graduates become leaders as teachers, advocates, consultants, and policymakers in public and private schools, higher education, human services agencies, private organizations, and correctional facilities. We also prepare students who want to continue their studies in doctoral programs. The program offers thesis and non-thesis options. Each concentration has a unique curriculum with courses that provide advanced skills and knowledge of research-based practices for individuals with disabilities. The M.Ed. in Special Education provides the foundation for those who aspire to work in areas such as: Teacher leaders in K-12 public and private schools, Teacher of children and youth with disabilities, Teacher in adult education and post-secondary settings, Advocates in non-profit and parent organizations, Consultants in education and human service agencies, Policy makers in state and federal agencies, Graduate students in doctoral studies in special education or related fields.
Program name: Master of Education in Special Education
Master of Education in Teaching

description: The MFA program in Design prepares students for careers as creative professionals, educators and leaders within a highly diverse range of fields. With courses ranging from traditional studio practice to emerging technologies, students learn to develop critical thinking, creative problem-solving and effective communication skills. A wide variety of research opportunities are available in topics such as user experience design, sustainability, cultural studies and new media.
Program name: Master of Fine Arts in Design with a concentration in Fashion Design
Master of Fine Arts in Design with a concentration in Interior Design

description: The Master of Fine Arts in Documentary Production and Studies program at the University of North Texas is designed to offer a unique, interdisciplinary approach to the practice and study of documentary. This three-year, 60-credit hour terminal degree will train a new generation of documentarians and scholars in both the creative and critical aspects of documentary, leading to careers as independent media makers, documentarians working within the media industry, and documentary scholars and teachers. Graduates will be prepared to produce, analyze, teach, and disseminate documentary in the 21st century. The program is specifically tailored to meet the needs of a diverse student population, including those with media production and/or academic backgrounds.
Program name: Master of Fine Arts in Documentary Production and Studies

description: The UNT Master of Fine Arts program in Studio Art is a rigorous studio-based curriculum that prepares students for professional careers as practicing artists. This program provides students with the opportunity to pursue advanced studies in ceramics, drawing and painting, new media, photography, printmaking, and sculpture.
Program name: Master of Fine Arts in Studio Art

description: The graduate program in jazz studies offers an in-depth curriculum designed for the student interested in advanced study of jazz performance, composition, arranging, and pedagogy. Students will develop advanced skills as performers, composers, and arrangers, and will gain a deeper understanding of jazz history, theory, and improvisation.
Program name: Master of Music in Jazz Studies

description: The Master of Music (MM) in Performance is a 30-credit-hour program offered through the College of Music. Students hone their skills in a chosen instrument, voice or conducting and deepen their knowledge of music history and theory. Graduate students prepare for careers as professional performers or college instructors. Many graduates go on to doctoral studies. Students may pursue a specialization in a number of areas including brass, guitar, harp, keyboard, organ, percussion, strings, voice and woodwinds. The UNT College of Music is one of the largest and most comprehensive music schools in the world and offers an unrivaled diversity of musical experiences and opportunities. With a faculty of more than 100 celebrated artists and scholars, and a student body of more than 1,600, UNT provides an ideal learning environment for talented musicians.
Program name: Master of Music in Performance

description: The Master of Music Education (M.M.E.) degree is designed to enhance the professional competence of music teachers who wish to continue developing as scholars and practitioners. The M.M.E. degree is offered with thesis and non-thesis options. The M.M.E. can be completed entirely online. The online option for the M.M.E. is especially designed for professional music educators seeking to develop advanced skills in research, critical thinking, teaching, and musicianship.
Program name: Master of Music Education

description: The Master of Public Administration (MPA) degree prepares students for careers in public service and nonprofit management. Students develop leadership and management skills, analytical and decision-making abilities, and an understanding of public policy processes and implementation. The program emphasizes ethical practice and social equity in public service. The MPA program is housed within the Department of Public Administration, a part of the College of Health and Public Service at the University of North Texas.
Accreditation status: The Master of Public Administration (MPA) program at the University of North Texas is fully accredited by the Network of Schools of Public Policy, Affairs, and Administration (NASPAA).
Program name: Master of Public Administration (MPA)

description: The Department of Accounting offers a Master of Science in Accounting (M.S.) degree program designed for students who have completed an undergraduate degree and wish to continue their education in accounting. Our program is designed to provide students with the advanced knowledge and skills necessary for successful careers in public accounting, industry, government, and not-for-profit organizations. The M.S. in Accounting offers two tracks: Audit and Data Analytics or Tax. Both tracks prepare students to meet the 150-hour education requirement for the CPA exam in Texas.
Program name: Master of Science in Accounting with a concentration in Audit and Data Analytics

description: The Master of Science in accounting offers two concentrations: Corporate Accounting and Taxation. This degree provides students with advanced study in accounting and business beyond the baccalaureate degree and helps prepare them to take a position as an accounting professional in industry, government or public accounting. For Texas residents, the degree helps satisfy the 150-semester hour educational requirement for certification as a Certified Public Accountant (CPA).
Program name: Master of Science in Accounting with a concentration in Corporate Accounting

description: The Master of Science (M.S.) in Advanced Data Analytics is an interdisciplinary program designed to meet the growing need for data scientists and analysts in various sectors. The program provides students with the advanced knowledge and skills necessary to collect, process, analyze, and interpret large and complex datasets. Graduates of the program will be equipped to apply data-driven approaches to solve real-world problems, make informed decisions, and develop innovative solutions in fields such as business, healthcare, government, and scientific research. The curriculum emphasizes both theoretical foundations and practical applications, covering topics such as statistical modeling, machine learning, data visualization, big data technologies, and ethical considerations in data analytics. The program is suitable for students with diverse academic backgrounds, including computer science, statistics, mathematics, information science, and other quantitative disciplines.
Program name: Master of Science in Advanced Data Analytics

description:
The Master of Science in Advanced Data Analytics degree program is a STEM-designated, research-oriented program leading to the degree of Master of Science (MS). The program prepares students with knowledge, skills and abilities required to apply data science concepts and techniques to solve real-world problems. Graduates from the program will possess strong analytical skills and be able to effectively communicate with executives, managers, and data analysts across various domains. The program has concentrations in analytics project management, business analytics and health data analytics.
Analytics Project Management Concentration provides students with knowledge and skills to manage analytics projects by integrating business and analytics knowledge. The concentration covers data analytics methods, data analysis tools, project management techniques, and business communication skills. Graduates from the program will be able to manage various types of analytics projects from project initiation to project closure. They will also be able to communicate effectively with stakeholders and lead diverse project teams.
Program name: Master of Science in Advanced Data Analytics with a concentration in Analytics Project Management

description: The Master of Science in Advanced Data Analytics with a concentration in Applied Artificial Intelligence is an interdisciplinary program designed to prepare students to contribute to the rapidly growing field of AI and data science. The program will enable students to gain the skills needed to collect, process, manage, analyze, and interpret large volumes of data and to leverage data to build intelligent systems with AI techniques and tools. The program is specifically tailored for those who want to advance or start a career in the field of data analytics and artificial intelligence. This program is offered by the College of Engineering. For more information, visit the departmental website.
Program name: Master of Science in Advanced Data Analytics with a concentration in Applied Artificial Intelligence

description: The Master of Science in Advanced Data Analytics program with a concentration in Digital Retailing prepares students to address the significant and increasing demand for data scientists with analytics expertise in the global retailing industry. Data scientists and data analysts are among the most sought-after professionals in the workforce, and this program builds on the strong foundation of the College of Merchandising, Hospitality and Tourism to provide an in-depth understanding of the retail industry through the lens of data analytics. The curriculum focuses on critical and current issues in retailing, including e-commerce, digital marketing, supply chain and logistics, and consumer experience, providing students with advanced analytical skills to extract insights from complex data sets. Graduates will be equipped to identify, interpret, and present data-driven solutions to real-world business challenges in a global and fast-paced retail environment.
Program name: Master of Science in Advanced Data Analytics with a concentration in Digital Retailing

description: The Master of Science in Advanced Data Analytics with a concentration in Geographic Information Systems (GIS) focuses on the principles and applications of advanced data analytics through the lens of GIS. This program is designed to provide students with the theoretical knowledge and practical skills necessary to analyze, interpret, and visualize complex spatial data using advanced analytical techniques and GIS software. Graduates will be prepared for careers in fields requiring expertise in spatial data science, geoinformatics, urban planning, environmental science, and public health, among others. The curriculum integrates core concepts of data analytics, statistics, machine learning, and data visualization with specialized courses in GIS, remote sensing, and spatial modeling. Students will engage in hands-on projects, case studies, and a culminating experience that applies their skills to real-world spatial data challenges.
Program name: Master of Science in Advanced Data Analytics with a concentration in Geographic Information Systems (GIS)

description: The Master of Science degree in Advanced Data Analytics focuses on preparing students to become specialists in the rapidly expanding field of data analytics in a variety of industries. This program provides students with the critical skills needed to gather, process, and analyze complex data sets across multiple disciplines, to identify trends and patterns, and to communicate data-driven insights effectively. This curriculum is designed to produce students with a deep knowledge of the application of data analytics, including the ethical and social implications inherent in the use of data. The program emphasizes both theoretical foundations and practical applications through a rigorous curriculum that incorporates various tools and techniques such as statistical analysis, machine learning, data visualization, and predictive modeling.
Program name: Master of Science in Advanced Data Analytics with a concentration in Geospatial Intelligence

description: The Master of Science program in Advanced Data Analytics is an interdisciplinary program designed to meet the growing demand for professionals skilled in using data to make informed decisions across a variety of fields. Students gain a comprehensive understanding of data collection, storage, processing, analysis, interpretation, and visualization, along with the ethical considerations and privacy issues surrounding data. The program emphasizes the practical application of data analytics techniques and tools through hands-on projects and real-world case studies. Students will develop critical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills essential for success in data-driven careers. Students in the MS in Advanced Data Analytics program may choose from one of eight concentrations designed to provide specialized knowledge and skills in particular application areas.
Program name: Master of Science in Advanced Data Analytics with a concentration in Health Data Analytics

description: The Master of Science in Advanced Data Analytics provides students with the fundamental knowledge and advanced skills to collect, manage, analyze, and interpret large volumes of data. Graduates will be prepared to contribute to the analysis of complex data and to use data science principles to improve decision-making. The program emphasizes both theoretical foundations and hands-on experience using industry-standard tools and techniques. Students are trained to use a variety of programming languages, statistical software, and database systems. The program is designed to meet the growing demand for data scientists and analysts in a variety of industries. The program is offered fully online.
Program name: Master of Science in Advanced Data Analytics with a concentration in Management

description: The Master of Science in Advanced Data Analytics is designed to train students in the most current techniques for extracting knowledge from large data sets and to provide in-depth training in the latest industry-standard software and analytical methodologies. This degree can be completed entirely online. The M.S. in Advanced Data Analytics offers a concentration in Sports. This concentration prepares students to analyze data in the sports industry, from player performance to fan engagement, and to apply data-driven insights to strategic decision-making in sports organizations.
Program name: Master of Science in Advanced Data Analytics with a concentration in Sports

description: The Master of Science (M.S.) in Advanced Data Analytics program is designed for students seeking to develop advanced skills in the fields of business analytics, health analytics, applied analytics, and statistics. The program provides a strong foundation in descriptive, predictive, and prescriptive analytics. The program prepares students for careers in fields such as data scientist, data analyst, business intelligence analyst, and analytics consultant. Students will learn to apply advanced statistical and machine learning techniques to real-world problems, interpret and communicate findings, and make data-driven decisions.
Program name: Master of Science in Advanced Data Analytics with a concentration in Statistics

description: The Master of Science program in Applied Behavior Analysis trains students in the scientific principles of behavior and their application to a wide range of human behaviors, including autism and related disabilities, behavioral medicine, education, and organizational behavior management. Students will be prepared to work in a variety of settings, including schools, clinics, homes, and organizations. Graduates of the program are eligible to apply for certification as Board Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBA) by the Behavior Analyst Certification Board® (BACB®). As a student in the Applied Behavior Analysis master’s program, you’ll learn: About the principles and methods of behavior analysis, including behavioral assessment, intervention, and research. How to apply these principles to a variety of populations and settings. The ethical and professional standards of behavior analysis. The skills to design, implement, and evaluate behavior analytic interventions. About current research and literature in applied behavior analysis.
Accreditation status: The Master of Science program in Applied Behavior Analysis at the University of North Texas includes a Verified Course Sequence (VCS) that meets the coursework requirements for eligibility to take the Board Certified Behavior Analyst® (BCBA®) Examination. This VCS has been verified by the Association for Behavior Analysis International (ABAI) and meets the requirements for eligibility to take the BCBA® Examination.
Program name: Master of Science in Applied Behavior Analysis

description: The Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence (MS in AI) is an interdisciplinary degree between Computer Science and Information Science. It prepares students for a career in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. The program gives students an in-depth understanding of theoretical and practical aspects of Artificial Intelligence. Graduates will be equipped to apply AI and Machine Learning techniques in various fields through data analytics, deep learning, natural language processing, intelligent agent development, and human-computer interaction. The program emphasizes the design, development, and application of artificial intelligence techniques for solving real-world problems. The MS in AI program focuses on cutting-edge topics that empower students with the skills and knowledge to meet the rapidly growing demand for AI professionals in industry, government, and research.
Program name: Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence

description: The Master of Science (M.S.) degree in Behavior Analysis at the University of North Texas is designed to provide graduate training in the experimental and applied analysis of behavior. The program helps prepare students for careers in research, teaching and practice (e.g., as Board Certified Behavior Analysts). Our program is designed for students who are interested in developing expertise in the application of behavioral principles to a wide variety of human behaviors (e.g., developmental disabilities, autism, education, child behavior, health & fitness, traumatic brain injury, organizational behavior management). As a result of this training, students will be qualified to enter various doctoral programs, teach at the university level, conduct research and work in a variety of settings applying the principles of behavior analysis. Students in the Master of Science in Behavior Analysis program will engage in course work, practicum experiences, and research that will result in the attainment of the following: Knowledge of the philosophical assumptions of behavior analysis, experimental analysis of behavior, applied behavior analysis, and professional practice. Skills in the experimental analysis of behavior, applied behavior analysis, and professional practice. Abilities to apply knowledge and skills in behavior analysis in professional and ethical ways.
Accreditation status: The Association for Behavior Analysis International has verified the following courses toward the coursework requirements for eligibility to take the Board Certified Behavior Analyst® or Board Certified Assistant Behavior Analyst® examination. Applicants will need to meet additional requirements before they can be deemed eligible to take the examination.
Program name: Master of Science in Behavior Analysis

description: A Master of Science in Biochemistry and Molecular Biology from the University of North Texas will prepare you to be a skilled and innovative professional in a wide range of biology-related careers. You will perform research in modern laboratories and acquire skills in critical thinking, experimental design, scientific methodology, data analysis and interpretation, and oral and written communication of scientific concepts. This program will provide you with a solid foundation in biochemistry and molecular biology, along with a deep understanding of experimental principles and practices. You will gain experience in a variety of laboratory techniques and technologies, including protein purification, electrophoresis, chromatography, spectroscopy, cloning, DNA sequencing, PCR, cell culture, microscopy, and bioinformatics. Our graduates pursue diverse career paths in areas such as biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, clinical research, forensics, agriculture, environmental science, and government. Many also continue their education in Ph.D. programs or medical school.
Program name: Master of Science in Biochemistry and Molecular Biology

description: The Department of Biological Sciences offers a Master of Science (MS) degree in Biology. This program is designed to provide advanced training and research opportunities in various biological disciplines. Our faculty members conduct research in areas such as cell biology, developmental biology, ecology, evolution, microbiology, molecular biology, neurobiology, plant biology, physiology and zoology. The program prepares students for further graduate study toward a doctoral degree, for careers in research, industry or government, or for teaching positions. Thesis and non-thesis options are available, though the thesis option is strongly encouraged.
Program name: Master of Science in Biology

description: This program is designed for current or prospective teachers of biology or related life sciences subjects at the secondary, community college or university levels. The curriculum for the M.S. degree in Biology (Teaching in the Life Sciences) includes course work in biology, biochemistry, science education, and research. Students can choose to complete either a thesis or a non-thesis option for the degree. This degree also has the flexibility to meet the needs of those seeking professional development or graduate work to meet their professional goals.
Program name: Master of Science in Biology (Teaching in the Life Sciences)

description: The Master of Science in Biology provides students with advanced training in biology at the graduate level, encompassing a broad range of topics from molecular biology to ecology and evolution. Students gain in-depth knowledge and research experience through coursework, seminars, and thesis or dissertation research. The program prepares students for careers in research, education, industry, and further doctoral studies. Concentrations allow students to specialize in areas such as Computational Life Science, Forensic Science, or General Biology.
Program name: Master of Science in Biology with a concentration in Computational Life Science

description: The Master of Science (MS) in Biology with a concentration in Sub-Antarctic Biocultural Conservation is a joint program offered in collaboration with the University of Magallanes, Chile (UMAG) and the Millennium Institute of Ecology and Biogeography (IEB). The program is designed to provide students with advanced knowledge and practical skills in biological and sociocultural conservation issues relevant to the Sub-Antarctic region. Students will engage in interdisciplinary coursework, research, and fieldwork, fostering a deep understanding of the unique ecosystems and cultural heritage of the Sub-Antarctic. The curriculum emphasizes a biocultural approach, integrating biological sciences with social sciences and humanities to address complex conservation challenges. Graduates will be prepared for careers in academia, research, non-governmental organizations, government agencies, and other institutions focused on conservation, sustainable development, and environmental policy in polar and sub-polar regions.
Program name: Master of Science in Biology with a concentration in Sub-Antarctic Biocultural Conservation

description: The Master of Science in Biomedical Engineering program prepares students to meet the growing need for highly qualified engineers in the medical device, biotechnology, and pharmaceutical industries. Students in the program will be exposed to coursework and research covering areas such as medical imaging, neural engineering, biomaterials, biomechanics, biomedical instrumentation, drug delivery, and computational biology. The program emphasizes both foundational biomedical engineering principles and practical applications through hands-on research and design projects. Graduates of the program will be well-prepared for advanced careers in industry, research, or further doctoral studies.
Program name: Master of Science in Biomedical Engineering
Master of Science in Business Analytics

description:
The Department of Chemistry offers graduate programs leading to the Master of Science and Doctor of Philosophy degrees. Graduate studies emphasize research that expands the understanding of all aspects of chemistry and its application to other fields of science.
The Master of Science in chemistry provides students with the advanced knowledge and skills necessary to pursue careers in industry, government, or academia, or to prepare for further doctoral study in chemistry or related fields. The program offers thesis and non-thesis options, allowing students to tailor their degree plan to their individual goals and interests. Students will develop a strong foundation in advanced chemical principles, laboratory techniques, and scientific communication.
Program name: Master of Science in Chemistry

description: The master’s degree in computer engineering prepares students for leadership roles in industry, government and education. Our multidisciplinary approach draws on the expertise of faculty in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering and the Department of Electrical Engineering. This enables students to combine courses from both disciplines to tailor a master’s program that meets their career goals. You’ll gain knowledge and skills in areas such as computer architecture, digital system design, embedded systems, very large scale integration (VLSI) design, testing, computer networks, digital signal processing, distributed processing, network-on-chip, VLSI circuit design and data communication. As a student in the program, you’ll be able to participate in a variety of research projects. Many faculty members in computer engineering are conducting research in areas such as embedded and real-time systems, VLSI design, fault-tolerant computing, computer networks, wireless networks, network security, computer architecture and performance evaluation.
Program name: Master of Science in Computer Engineering

description:
The Department of Computer Science and Engineering offers a Master of Science degree with a major in computer science. The program’s educational objectives are to prepare graduates to:

*   Obtain leadership positions in industry, government and academia through advanced knowledge and skills in computer science.
*   Become involved in lifelong learning as demonstrated by continued professional growth and development, including entrepreneurial pursuits.
*   Participate in professional activities ethically and responsibly.
*   Provide technical leadership in areas of professional practice.
*   Continue on to a Ph.D. program.
Program name: Master of Science in Computer Science

Concentration name: Clinical Mental Health Counseling, School Counseling, Play Therapy
description: The UNT M.S. in Counseling program provides students with the academic and experiential knowledge and skills required for careers in a variety of settings. Students completing the program may become licensed professional counselors, school counselors, or registered play therapists in Texas. Our program is a Council for Accreditation of Counseling and Related Educational Programs (CACREP) accredited program in Clinical Mental Health Counseling and School Counseling. We focus on preparing professional counselors who are grounded in theory, research, and best practices. As a student, you will have the opportunity to engage in meaningful scholarly discourse and fieldwork experiences within a supportive and collaborative environment.
Accreditation status: Council for Accreditation of Counseling and Related Educational Programs (CACREP) accredited program in Clinical Mental Health Counseling and School Counseling.
Program name: Master of Science in Counseling

description: The Master of Science in Criminal Justice provides students with an advanced education in the criminal justice field. The degree is designed to prepare students for careers in criminal justice, for doctoral studies in criminal justice or related fields, and for research positions in justice agencies and organizations. The concentration in Justice Policy and Administration prepares students for leadership and administrative positions in the criminal justice system. The concentration focuses on a variety of topics relevant to administration, policy, and evaluation, including personnel management, financial management, policy analysis and implementation, and program evaluation. Students will develop skills in critical thinking, research, and analysis to address complex issues in criminal justice administration and policy. The degree requires 30 semester hours of course work beyond the bachelor’s degree.
Program name: Master of Science in Criminal Justice with a concentration in Justice Policy and Administration

description: The Department of Criminal Justice offers graduate work leading to the Master of Science degree in Criminal Justice with concentrations in Cybercrime, Homeland Security, or Theory and Research. The program provides students with knowledge of the criminal justice system and the theoretical and empirical underpinnings of justice studies. Students pursuing the M.S. degree prepare for careers in various criminal justice agencies, for further study in a doctoral program, or for teaching positions in community colleges. The department is a part of the College of Health and Public Service.
Program name: Master of Science in Criminal Justice with a concentration in Theory and Research
Master of Science in Cybersecurity

description: The Master of Science (M.S.) program with a major in Data Engineering prepares students for careers as data engineers, data scientists and other related data-intensive professions in industry and government. Data engineering is a broad field of study at the intersection of computer science, data science, information science, and statistics focused on the acquisition, integration, management, and analysis of large volumes of data. The curriculum provides students with expertise in data analytics, data science, big data management, machine learning, and cloud computing. This is a STEM designated program.
Program name: Master of Science in Data Engineering

description: The Department of Information Science offers a Master of Science (MS) in Data Science program. This program is designed for individuals who want to develop strong theoretical and practical expertise in data science, including the skills needed to collect, store, retrieve, process, analyze, visualize and interpret large amounts of data. This interdisciplinary degree prepares students for a career as a data scientist, business intelligence analyst, machine learning engineer, data analyst, data architect and more, across various industries. Students will learn how to apply various data science methods and tools to derive valuable insights, create models and make decisions in real-world applications.
Program name: Master of Science in Data Science

description: Interaction Design focuses on designing interactive digital products, environments, systems, and services. Students learn to apply user-centered design principles and processes, develop prototypes, conduct user research, and evaluate user experiences. The curriculum covers areas such as usability, accessibility, information architecture, interface design, and emerging technologies. Graduates are prepared for careers as UX designers, product designers, interaction designers, and design researchers in various industries, including technology, healthcare, education, and entertainment.
Program name: Master of Science in Design with a concentration in Interaction Design

description: Digital communication analytics is a rapidly expanding field that explores how data informs, defines, and transforms communication strategy and practice in organizational and professional contexts. Through coursework rooted in communication, analytics, and business, you'll learn how to leverage social media data, web analytics, and other sources of information to enhance an organization's strategic communication efforts. Our online Master of Science (MS) in Digital Communication Analytics prepares students for leadership roles that require the ability to conduct, interpret, and apply advanced digital communication data analysis. Graduates emerge with a strong professional skill set that integrates theoretical knowledge with practical application. The MS in Digital Communication Analytics will empower you to collect and analyze complex data, generate actionable insights, and develop effective communication strategies for an evolving digital landscape.
Program name: Master of Science in Digital Communication Analytics

description: The Master of Science (M.S.) with a major in Early Childhood Education (M.S. in ECE) provides advanced professional and scholarly studies in the education and development of young children. Through this program, students develop advanced knowledge and skills in evidence-based early childhood education, including early childhood curriculum, teaching, policy, and research. This program provides expertise in the development of young children from birth through age 8.
Program name: Master of Science in Early Childhood Education

description: The Master of Science in Economics program is designed to provide students with a strong foundation in economic theory, econometrics, and quantitative methods. Graduates of the program are well-prepared for a variety of careers in both the public and private sectors, including roles as economists, data analysts, researchers, and consultants. The program also serves as excellent preparation for doctoral studies in economics or related fields. Our faculty members are active researchers dedicated to both teaching and advancing the frontiers of economic knowledge across a wide range of fields. The Department of Economics is committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive learning environment that encourages critical thinking, analytical rigor, and independent research.
Program name: Master of Science in Economics

description: The Master of Science in Educational Psychology program helps students understand how people learn and develop throughout their lives, focusing on the cognitive, social, and emotional factors that influence learning. Our program emphasizes the practical application of theory, research, and assessment methods to solve problems across diverse educational and developmental settings. The M.S. in Educational Psychology program offers both a thesis and non-thesis option for students interested in research, academia, or professional roles related to educational psychology. Graduates are prepared for careers in educational settings, research organizations, government agencies, and non-profit organizations. This program is offered completely online.
Program name: Master of Science in Educational Psychology

Concentration name: communication and signal processing, control systems, digital systems, electronic devices and circuits, electromagnetics, power systems
description: The Master of Science program in Electrical Engineering provides students with an advanced background in either communication and signal processing, control systems, digital systems, electronic devices and circuits, electromagnetics, or power systems. The program provides advanced studies to students interested in careers in industry and government, or in continued studies leading to the PhD degree. The Department of Electrical Engineering offers thesis and non-thesis options for the M.S. degree.
Program name: Master of Science in Electrical Engineering

description: The Master of Science in Emergency Management and Disaster Science prepares students to be leaders and innovators in the emergency management and disaster fields. The degree is designed to prepare students for careers in complex and dynamic emergency environments, addressing the multi-disciplinary needs of organizations and communities. Students will gain knowledge in the latest theory and practice, including topics such as: social vulnerability to disaster, emergency planning, hazard mitigation, disaster response and recovery, public policy, and risk assessment.
Program name: Master of Science in Emergency Management and Disaster Science

description: The Master of Science in Engineering Management provides students with a broad and in-depth education in the management of engineering and technical enterprises. The program is designed for engineers and other professionals with technical backgrounds to gain skills and knowledge in leadership, business strategy, project management, operations, and organizational behavior. It prepares graduates for management and leadership positions in technology-intensive organizations.
Program name: Master of Science in Engineering Management

description: The Department of Environmental Science offers programs leading to the Master of Science degree (M.S.) and Doctor of Philosophy degree (Ph.D.) in Environmental Science. The Master of Science degree is designed to prepare graduates for careers in environmental assessment and management within a variety of governmental agencies, private companies and consulting firms. Students are required to complete a thesis for the M.S. degree. The Ph.D. degree is designed to prepare graduates for careers in academia, industry and government that require advanced research and analysis capabilities. A terminal M.S. degree is offered to students who do not desire to continue in the Ph.D. program. A student must maintain an overall 3.0 grade point average or better in all courses taken that count toward the degree.
Program name: Master of Science in Environmental Science

description: The Master of Science in Finance program provides advanced training in finance for students seeking careers in corporate finance, investment management, or risk management. The program is designed to provide students with the quantitative and analytical skills necessary to succeed in a dynamic global financial environment. The curriculum covers a broad range of financial topics, including financial modeling, valuation, portfolio management, risk management, and financial institutions. Graduates of the program are prepared for a variety of finance-related positions in corporations, financial institutions, and government agencies.
Program name: Master of Science in Finance

description: Our Master of Science program offers students the opportunity for advanced study in theoretical and applied geography. Graduates of our program are well prepared for careers in fields such as GIS, remote sensing, environmental management, urban and regional planning, and other areas where geographic skills are in demand. Many of our graduates also continue their education in doctoral programs. Thesis and non-thesis options are available in our programs.
Program name: Master of Science in Geography

description: The Geography master's program offers a Master of Science (M.S.) degree with thesis or non-thesis options and a concentration in data analytics. The program prepares students for professional careers and doctoral studies. Our curriculum emphasizes the acquisition of knowledge in theoretical geography, quantitative methods, and geographic information science (GISc), with applications to a variety of human and physical geography topics. Students learn to apply geographic concepts, theories, and methods to interpret spatial patterns and processes. Our graduates have pursued careers in fields such as GIS and remote sensing, data science, environmental management, urban and regional planning, and international development, as well as positions in government agencies, non-profits, and private industry.
Program name: Master of Science in Geography with a Concentration in Data Analytics

description: The Master of Science (MS) in Geography offers a flexible course of study and a variety of concentration areas. The graduate program provides rigorous training in geographic theory and methods and opportunities for students to apply this training to problems related to spatial analysis, environmental geography, and human-environment interactions. Students completing the MS in Geography will be well-prepared for a variety of careers in government, nonprofit, and private sectors; and for Ph.D. studies in Geography or related fields.
Program name: Master of Science in Geography with a Concentration in Technical Communication

description: The Master of Science in Health Data Analytics at the University of North Texas equips students with critical data science and analytics skills while developing a deeper understanding of the processes and operations within the healthcare system. With courses in health informatics, data analytics, and statistics, students will learn to derive insights from health data and apply them to healthcare challenges. This program offers practical skills for working with big data, including advanced statistical analysis, machine learning, deep learning, data visualization, and information technology relevant to the healthcare industry. Our curriculum is designed to prepare students to advance their careers and become leaders in the rapidly growing field of health data analytics.
Program name: Master of Science in Health Data Analytics

description: The graduate program in Health Informatics provides an interdisciplinary approach to the design, development, and application of technology to improve patient care, enhance health care delivery, and improve population health. The master's program focuses on the core areas of health informatics including: health data analysis, health information systems, health care delivery systems, and health care policy. The program is designed to provide students with the knowledge and skills necessary to become successful health informatics professionals in a variety of settings, including hospitals, clinics, public health agencies, and research institutions. The program offers both thesis and non-thesis options.
Program name: Master of Science in Health Informatics

description: The Master of Science (M.S.) program in Health Services Administration (HSA) prepares students to become leaders in healthcare organizations and related enterprises. This program prepares students for positions in various healthcare organizations and settings. Students acquire the knowledge and skills necessary to contribute to the efficient and effective delivery of high-quality, accessible and affordable healthcare. The curriculum provides a strong foundation in healthcare management, economics, finance, policy, law, ethics, marketing, human resources and information systems. The program provides the knowledge and skills necessary to succeed in a dynamic and challenging healthcare environment. Graduates are prepared for careers as administrators, managers, and policy analysts in hospitals, clinics, nursing homes, public health agencies, and other healthcare organizations. The HSA program provides students with the opportunity to specialize in a particular area of healthcare administration through their internship and capstone project. In addition, the HSA program prepares students for doctoral study in health services research, health policy, or other related fields.
Program name: Master of Science in Health Services Administration

Concentration name: Digital Hospitality and Tourism Management, Revenue Management and Analytics
description: The M.S. in Hospitality and Tourism Data Analytics program at UNT prepares students for advanced careers in the rapidly growing fields of hospitality, tourism, and data analytics. Students gain expertise in data-driven decision-making, predictive analytics, revenue management, digital marketing, and strategic management through a comprehensive curriculum. The program caters to individuals seeking to lead in the digital transformation of the hospitality and tourism industry, offering a blend of theoretical knowledge and practical application. This program prepares graduates to thrive in an era where data-driven insights are paramount. Graduates are equipped with skills in data interpretation, strategic forecasting, and digital innovation, making them highly sought after in various sectors of the hospitality and tourism industry.
Program name: Master of Science in Hospitality and Tourism Data Analytics

description: The Department of Hospitality and Tourism Management offers a Master of Science (M.S.) in Hospitality Management. The Hospitality Management M.S. program is designed to educate and develop professionals, educators, and scholars for diverse career opportunities in the hospitality and tourism industry. The program provides the necessary knowledge and skills for managing the human resources, financial, technological, and service challenges facing the global hospitality and tourism industry, as well as for further doctoral studies.
Program name: Master of Science in Hospitality Management

description: The online Master of Science degree in Hospitality Management will help prepare you to advance in the diverse hospitality, tourism, and gaming industries. You’ll be able to demonstrate advanced knowledge of hospitality management and apply critical thinking skills for decision making. You’ll also be able to conduct research and analyze data related to contemporary hospitality issues.
Program name: Master of Science in Hospitality Management (online)

description: The Master of Science in Information Science (MS-IS) is designed for students seeking careers as information professionals in all types of information environments, including academic, public and special libraries, cultural heritage institutions, governmental agencies, and corporate and non-profit organizations. The program offers several concentrations, allowing students to tailor their studies to specific career goals. The curriculum provides a strong foundation in information science principles, theories, and practices, preparing students for leadership roles in a rapidly evolving information landscape.
Accreditation status: The Master of Science in Information Science program is accredited by the American Library Association (ALA).
Program name: Master of Science in Information Science

description: The Master of Science (M.S.) in Information Science prepares students for a wide variety of information-related careers. The program develops knowledgeable and competent information professionals, well-versed in information management, organization, and use. Graduates are prepared for careers such as archivists, data scientists, health informatics specialists, information architects, information literacy instructors, information and knowledge managers, information system specialists, librarians, records managers, and user experience (UX) designers.
Accreditation status: The American Library Association (ALA) accredits the UNT Master of Science (M.S.) in Information Science. This accreditation applies to all specializations, including the Master of Science (M.S.) in Information Science and the Master of Science (M.S.) in Information Science with a specialization in School Library Certification.
Program name: Master of Science in Information Science with a concentration in Archival Studies

description: The Master of Science in Information Science program at the University of North Texas is designed to prepare students for leadership roles in various information professions. Students acquire the knowledge and skills necessary to organize, retrieve, and disseminate information in diverse environments such as libraries, archives, museums, information agencies, and data analytics firms. The curriculum emphasizes critical thinking, problem-solving, and ethical considerations in information management. Graduates are prepared to contribute to a rapidly evolving information landscape, addressing complex challenges in information access, organization, and utilization. The Health Librarianship concentration prepares students for professional positions in health sciences libraries and information centers. Students gain expertise in medical informatics, health information resources, consumer health information, and specialized services for healthcare professionals and patients.
Program name: Master of Science in Information Science with a concentration in Health Librarianship

description: The Information Organization concentration helps students understand the structures and processes used to organize information, including metadata, indexing, abstracting, classification, and taxonomy. Students learn how to apply these structures and processes to meet user information needs in a variety of settings.
Accreditation status: The Master of Science program in Information Science is accredited by the American Library Association (ALA), 225 N. Michigan Ave., Suite 1300, Chicago, IL 60601-7616. The program is in good standing.
Program name: Master of Science in Information Science with a concentration in Information Organization

description: The Master of Science in Information Science is designed to prepare professionals to provide leadership in the rapidly changing information environment. Graduates of the program are prepared to assume responsible positions in a wide variety of information-intensive organizations. The program focuses on the organization and analysis of information, information technology, information seeking and use, and the management of information organizations and systems.
Program name: Master of Science in Information Science with a concentration in Information Systems

description: The Master of Science in Information Science (MSIS) program provides advanced graduate education for professionals in the field of information science. Information science is an interdisciplinary field that seeks to understand, analyze, and manage information in various forms and contexts. It draws on theories and practices from computer science, cognitive science, library science, and other disciplines to address the challenges and opportunities of the information age. The program offers a range of specializations allowing students to tailor their studies to their interests and career goals. Concentrations include archival studies, data science, digital content and information management, health informatics, human-computer interaction, information organization, information systems, knowledge management, metadata and discovery, school library media, sport entertainment information and analytics, storage and preservation, and user experience design. The MSIS program is designed for students with a bachelor's degree in any field who are interested in pursuing a career in information science. It is also suitable for professionals who wish to enhance their skills and knowledge in this rapidly evolving field. Graduates of the program are prepared for a variety of roles in information science, including information architects, data analysts, knowledge managers, user experience designers, and information consultants. The program emphasizes critical thinking, problem-solving, and practical skills development, enabling students to address real-world challenges in diverse information environments. The MSIS program is an online program.
Accreditation status: Approved by the Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board. The MSIS program is not accredited by the American Library Association (ALA).
Program name: Master of Science in Information Science with a concentration in Knowledge Management

Concentration name: Business Information Systems (BIS), Cyber Security (CS), Information Technology (IT)
description: The Master of Science in Information Systems and Technologies (M.S.I.S.T.) is designed to provide students with a balance of in-depth theoretical knowledge in information systems and technologies with practical applications relevant to managerial and technical challenges. The program prepares students for leadership positions as information technology specialists, project managers, systems analysts, information technology consultants and other management positions in government, not-for-profit organizations and private industry. The curriculum prepares students to manage, operate, and maintain computing resources and their applications as they relate to organizational needs, and to keep pace with an ever-changing environment in information technology.
Accreditation status: Accredited by AACSB International – The Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business.
Program name: Master of Science in Information Systems and Technologies

description: The Master of Science in Interdisciplinary Studies degree offers a unique opportunity to design a master’s program tailored to your interests and career goals. Working with a faculty advisor, you'll combine courses from three distinct disciplines across the university to create a cohesive course of study. This flexible, customizable program allows you to integrate knowledge from various fields, fostering critical thinking, problem-solving, and adaptability. Whether you're looking to advance in a specific field, transition careers, or pursue a unique academic path, the M.S. in Interdisciplinary Studies equips you with a broad skill set applicable to a wide range of professions. The M.S. in Interdisciplinary Studies is a 36-credit-hour program. You will choose three areas of study from at least two different colleges and complete 12 credit hours in each area. You will also complete a 3-credit-hour capstone experience.
Program name: Master of Science in Interdisciplinary Studies

description:
The Master of Science in Interdisciplinary Studies (MSIS) with a concentration in Advanced Data Analytics is for students who want to develop practical, relevant and current skills to effectively use data as a critical resource for business, government and research. The program focuses on quantitative and computational methods, statistical learning, modeling and prediction, and provides students with skills in:
*   Big Data/Data Mining
*   Machine Learning
*   Statistical Analysis
*   Data Visualization
*   Predictive Modeling
*   Programming in R and Python
Program name: Master of Science in Interdisciplinary Studies with a concentration in Advanced Data Analytics

description: UNT’s Master of Science in Interdisciplinary Studies with a concentration in Applied Analytics prepares you to use data analysis techniques to solve real-world problems. In this program, you will learn to apply predictive and prescriptive models to generate insights that inform strategic decision-making in a wide range of fields. You’ll be prepared for careers as data scientists, business intelligence analysts, or consultants in finance, marketing, logistics, government, health care and more. The curriculum is interdisciplinary, blending courses from business, computer science, and mathematics to give you a comprehensive understanding of analytics. Our program emphasizes hands-on experience, with opportunities for internships and projects that apply your skills to practical challenges.
