The program offers concentrations in Biomedical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Materials and Manufacturing Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Mechanical and Energy Engineering with a concentration in Biomedical Engineering

Concentration name: Composition, Ethnomusicology, Music Education, Music History, Music Theory
description: The Doctor of Philosophy in Music degree is designed for students who demonstrate the highest promise of becoming creative scholars and leaders in various areas of academic and professional life related to music. Candidates for the Ph.D. in Music at UNT are expected to develop original and independent research agendas in their areas of specialization and to possess an excellent background in their proposed area of concentration, as well as a broad understanding of the historical and theoretical dimensions of music. The rigorous program of study, which includes course work, examinations, and an original dissertation, is highly individualized and designed to prepare students for academic careers in university and college settings, as well as for other careers in which advanced academic work is required.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Music

description: The PhD in Music Education prepares students to be leaders in the profession through advanced coursework, research and teaching opportunities. Students in the program develop expertise in research and scholarship as well as music pedagogy and philosophy. Graduates often teach in higher education, hold leadership positions in professional organizations, or engage in curriculum development at the state or national level.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Music Education
Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Philosophy
Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Philosophy with a concentration in Human Geography
Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Physics

description: The Doctor of Philosophy in Political Science requires students to develop theoretical knowledge and research skills across two major subfields within political science. Students receive methodological training in a variety of quantitative and qualitative techniques. The program trains students for careers as university professors and researchers, as well as for positions in government and non-profit organizations. Students choose two of the following major subfields: American politics, comparative politics, international relations, political theory, and public law. In addition, students may select an optional cognate/minor in a field closely related to their major subfields.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Political Science

description: The PhD in Public Administration and Management is an advanced degree for students seeking careers in university teaching, research and public service. Graduates will be prepared to conduct theoretical and applied research on important issues facing public and nonprofit organizations; teach courses in public administration, management, public policy, and urban affairs; and apply scholarly knowledge to improve the practice of public service and management. The program builds on a strong commitment to quality teaching and research in the Department of Public Administration in the College of Health and Public Service.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Public Administration and Management

description: Our doctorate in sociology provides students with a strong theoretical and methodological foundation in the discipline and the opportunity to specialize in an area of interest. We prepare students for positions in teaching and research, as well as for work in applied settings. Graduates of our program work in colleges and universities, research centers, and nonprofit organizations, as well as in state and federal government. The program faculty are committed to creating an environment where students engage in an intensive, yet supportive, intellectual community.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Sociology

description: The UNT Doctoral program in Special Education provides advanced study in an area of focus related to special education, as well as general knowledge in research methodology, statistics and higher education teaching. Our doctoral students prepare for roles as university professors, researchers, and educational leaders and administrators. The Ph.D. in Special Education provides students with in-depth knowledge and skills in teaching, research, and service. Throughout the program, students will engage in relevant coursework, research experiences, and teaching opportunities. Doctoral students complete a minimum of 60 post-master's credit hours, including 15 hours of core coursework, 15 hours of research courses, 15 hours in an area of emphasis, 9 hours of teaching experience/internship, and 6 hours of dissertation. After coursework is completed, students are required to pass comprehensive examinations and successfully propose and defend a dissertation.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Special Education

description:
The Graduate Academic Certificate in Advanced Data Analytics in Economics is offered in the Department of Economics. This certificate is designed for individuals who have completed a bachelor’s degree and are looking to enhance their quantitative and analytical skills in data analytics as applied to economics. The certificate is also suitable for students pursuing a master's or doctoral degree who wish to gain a deeper understanding of advanced data analytics tools and methodologies relevant to economics without committing to a full master's degree in economics or data analytics.
The certificate program provides students with practical skills in economic data analysis, econometric modeling, machine learning techniques, and data visualization. Students will learn to apply these tools to analyze economic data, make informed decisions, and solve complex economic problems. The program emphasizes hands-on experience with industry-standard software and real-world datasets, preparing graduates for careers in data science, economic consulting, financial analysis, and research roles in both the public and private sectors.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Advanced Data Analytics in Economics
Graduate Academic Certificate in Advanced Humanities Pedagogy

description:
The Advanced Management in Libraries and Information Agencies Graduate Academic Certificate from the University of North Texas is designed for information professionals who wish to expand their leadership and management skills and knowledge. This online program enhances the management skills of librarians and other information professionals, preparing them to take on leadership roles within libraries and information agencies.
As a student in the program, you’ll focus on the essential foundations for effective library and information center management, including information policy, human resources, budgeting, fundraising, grant writing and strategic planning. These skills are vital in today’s rapidly changing information environments and will provide you with the tools necessary to excel in leadership positions.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Advanced Management in Libraries and Information Agencies

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Advanced Manufacturing provides an opportunity for graduates with a bachelor’s degree in engineering or a closely related field to enhance their understanding of advanced manufacturing processes and systems. The certificate provides skills in fundamental manufacturing sciences and the development of new manufacturing processes/systems, with an emphasis on interdisciplinary collaboration. Students will acquire the knowledge and skills necessary to contribute to the rapidly evolving field of advanced manufacturing, which encompasses areas such as additive manufacturing, smart manufacturing, and sustainable manufacturing.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Advanced Manufacturing

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in AI in Education provides students with foundational and advanced knowledge of artificial intelligence concepts, applications, and ethical implications within educational contexts. This certificate is designed for educators, instructional designers, curriculum developers, and professionals in related fields who seek to integrate AI technologies effectively into teaching, learning, and administrative processes. Students will explore cutting-edge AI tools, machine learning principles, natural language processing, and data analytics relevant to education, preparing them to innovate and lead in the evolving landscape of AI-driven education.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in AI in Education

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Analytics Project Management is a 12-hour certificate designed to provide students with the knowledge and skills necessary to be an analytics project leader. With increasing pressure to create value through analytics and a significant shortage of analytics project managers, students will be prepared to lead such projects in organizations upon completion of this certificate. The curriculum covers the tools and techniques necessary for project execution, as well as the unique aspects of managing analytics projects and how they differ from traditional projects.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Analytics Project Management

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Applied Behavior Analysis (GAC-ABA) at the University of North Texas is designed to provide students with the academic coursework required to sit for the Board Certified Behavior Analyst® (BCBA®) examination. The program emphasizes ethical practice, evidence-based interventions, and practical application of behavioral principles. The UNT GAC-ABA program is verified by the Association for Behavior Analysis International® (ABAI®) as meeting the coursework requirements for eligibility to take the Board Certified Behavior Analyst® (BCBA®) examination. Upon completion of the GAC-ABA program, students will be able to apply behavior analytic principles to assess and treat socially significant behavior, design and implement evidence-based behavioral interventions, conduct ethical practice as a behavior analyst, analyze and interpret data to make informed treatment decisions, and communicate effectively with clients, families, and interdisciplinary teams.
Accreditation status: Verified by the Association for Behavior Analysis International® (ABAI®) as meeting the coursework requirements for eligibility to take the Board Certified Behavior Analyst® (BCBA®) examination.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Applied Behavior Analysis

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Applied Sociology provides students with knowledge and skills relevant to applying sociological knowledge to real-world problems. The certificate can be completed as a stand-alone program or in conjunction with a master's or doctoral degree in sociology or related fields. The program prepares students for careers in research, policy analysis, program evaluation, and community development in governmental, non-profit, and private organizations. The certificate requires 12 graduate credit hours. The Applied Sociology certificate prepares students to apply sociological theory and research methods to analyze social problems, develop and evaluate interventions, and communicate findings to diverse audiences. Graduates will be equipped to work in various settings, including government agencies, non-profit organizations, and private businesses, as researchers, analysts, evaluators, and consultants.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Applied Sociology

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Archival Management is designed for students interested in a focused course of study that offers a solid foundation of theoretical and practical training in all aspects of archival work. It provides an excellent credential for those seeking entry-level professional positions and for those already working in archives who wish to enhance their qualifications. It is intended for individuals who have already earned a master's degree or are currently enrolled in a master's degree program.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Archival Management
Graduate Academic Certificate in Art Museum Education

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Artificial Intelligence is designed for post-baccalaureate students who want to develop or expand their knowledge and skills in this rapidly growing field. Students will learn the fundamental concepts and practical applications of AI, including machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, and computer vision. The program emphasizes hands-on experience with AI tools and technologies, preparing students for careers in various industries or for further graduate study. Courses taken for this certificate may be applied to the Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence program, contingent upon program requirements and advisor approval.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Artificial Intelligence

description: The Certificate in Autism Intervention is an advanced graduate program for professionals who work or wish to work with individuals with autism spectrum disorder (ASD). This 15-hour certificate provides training to graduate students, teachers, speech-language pathologists, occupational therapists, physical therapists, social workers, school psychologists, board-certified behavior analysts, and other professionals who support individuals with autism spectrum disorder. It includes coursework and supervised practicum experiences relevant to various intervention strategies for individuals with ASD across the lifespan. The program is offered online. Graduates of this certificate will be prepared to work as practitioners in schools, hospitals, clinics, and private agencies that provide services for individuals with ASD.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Autism Intervention

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Big Data and Intelligent Systems is designed for students who desire to enhance their understanding of big data systems, intelligent systems, and analytics, and how they apply to the real world. This certificate is well suited for students with a background in computer science, computer engineering, information technology, or a related field. Upon completion, students will be able to apply advanced knowledge in the areas of big data analytics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to tackle real-world problems. The program also prepares students for careers in the growing fields of data science and artificial intelligence.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Big Data and Intelligent Systems

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Children's and Young Adult Library and Community Services prepares students for careers working in public and school libraries, and other community organizations that serve children and young adults. Students completing this certificate will gain knowledge and skills for managing, evaluating, and designing services to children and young adults. The program emphasizes community outreach, literacy, advocacy, technology, collection development, and programming in different settings.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Children's and Young Adult Library and Community Services

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Community College Leadership program provides an opportunity for master’s and doctoral degree holders to acquire a graduate certificate in Community College Leadership. The certificate prepares graduates for leadership positions within community colleges. The program focuses on providing knowledge and skills that promote success in leadership roles in the community college context. The program requires 15 graduate credit hours of coursework in educational administration. All courses are delivered online.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Community College Leadership

description:
Computational linguistics is an interdisciplinary field between computer science and linguistics. It focuses on developing computer models of natural language to solve language-related problems. Examples of computational linguistics applications include spell checking, grammar checking, machine translation, spam filtering, text summarization, speech recognition, and information extraction.
The Certificate in Computational Linguistics at UNT is designed for students who are interested in developing advanced computational linguistics skills. The certificate targets graduate students in linguistics, computer science, and related areas. Our curriculum offers a solid foundation in computational linguistics theory and applications with a balance between theoretical and practical training. We encourage students to gain hands-on experience by completing projects on authentic computational linguistics problems using real-world data and open-source software tools.
Upon completing the certificate program, students will be able to demonstrate:
*   Solid understanding of computational linguistics theory and applications
*   Ability to implement computational linguistics techniques to solve real-world problems
*   Experience using open-source computational linguistics software tools
*   Skills in evaluating computational linguistics systems
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Computational Linguistics

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Cultural Heritage Stewardship (CHS) at the University of North Texas provides students with knowledge and skills to preserve, manage, and interpret cultural heritage. The certificate is offered primarily online, with an option for some face-to-face courses. The certificate is designed for students seeking entry-level positions in cultural heritage organizations or current professionals looking to advance their careers. Courses focus on the theories, principles, practices, and technologies used in cultural heritage stewardship. Students learn how to manage cultural heritage resources, engage with diverse communities, apply ethical practices, and utilize relevant technologies. The program culminates in a capstone project where students apply their knowledge to a real-world cultural heritage challenge.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Cultural Heritage Stewardship

description: Designed for business professionals seeking to enhance their knowledge and skills in the growing field of data analytics, the Graduate Academic Certificate in Data Analytics will introduce students to the analytical skills and business insight required to convert raw data into meaningful and actionable information. This certificate is valuable to students with varied educational backgrounds including business, sciences, humanities, and fine arts. The curriculum will focus on developing statistical programming skills to facilitate the analysis of large datasets, an understanding of fundamental data visualization techniques, and the ability to interpret and communicate results effectively within a business context.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Data Analytics

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Data Engineering provides students with an in-depth understanding of the principles, techniques, and tools required to design, implement, and manage robust and scalable data engineering solutions. The certificate aims to equip students with the necessary skills to address the growing demand for professionals who can build and maintain data pipelines, data warehouses, and data lakes effectively. The curriculum focuses on practical applications and hands-on experience, preparing students for successful careers in data-intensive industries.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Data Engineering

description: Data scientists are in high demand and needed across industries. Become a part of this growing field through the University of North Texas’ online Graduate Academic Certificate in Data Science. As a student in this program, you will develop the knowledge and skills necessary to prepare you for careers in data science. Our courses cover topics such as data visualization, data mining, machine learning, deep learning, statistical analysis, and programming. Through the Data Science Graduate Academic Certificate, you will learn to apply computational and statistical analysis to large data sets. Other topics include: Data collection and cleansing, Data visualization, Data mining, Data-driven decision making, Machine learning, Deep learning, Statistical analysis, Programming, Natural Language Processing, Artificial intelligence.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Data Science

description: As the digital landscape expands, the ability to analyze and interpret data from online communication channels becomes increasingly vital for organizations. The Graduate Academic Certificate in Digital Communication Analytics is designed to equip students with the skills to strategically collect, analyze, and apply data to improve digital communication strategies. This certificate offers a focused curriculum that covers areas such as web analytics, social media analytics, data visualization, and ethical considerations in data analysis. Graduates will be prepared to leverage data-driven insights to optimize campaigns, enhance user engagement, and make informed decisions in a variety of communication-related roles. This certificate is ideal for professionals seeking to advance their careers in marketing, public relations, corporate communication, or related fields, and who wish to specialize in the analytical aspects of digital communication.
Accreditation status: The University of North Texas is accredited by the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges (SACSCOC) to award baccalaureate, master’s and doctoral degrees.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Digital Communication Analytics

description: The graduate academic certificate in Digital Content Management prepares students for a career in the dynamic field of digital content. The program will provide students with competencies to create, manage, preserve and disseminate digital content and assets for various types of organizations using a variety of formats and platforms. Students will acquire the skills necessary to identify and implement best practices for digital content creation, acquisition, and curation. The certificate can be completed in conjunction with an M.S. degree in Information Science or as a stand-alone certificate.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Digital Content Management

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Digital Curation and Data Management addresses the growing demand for professionals skilled in managing digital assets throughout their lifecycle. This 12-hour certificate program provides students with the foundational knowledge and practical skills needed to curate, preserve, and provide access to digital data in various institutional settings. Students will learn about data governance, metadata standards, digital preservation strategies, and the ethical considerations involved in managing digital information. The curriculum emphasizes hands-on experience with relevant tools and technologies, preparing graduates for roles in libraries, archives, museums, government agencies, and corporate environments. The certificate is suitable for current information professionals seeking to enhance their skills, as well as for graduate students interested in specializing in digital curation and data management.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Digital Curation and Data Management

description: This certificate is an 18-credit-hour program offered through the Department of Merchandising and Digital Retailing. This certificate will provide students with specialized knowledge in digital retail merchandising, including retail buying, product development, global sourcing, and e-commerce. Students will gain an understanding of current technologies and strategies used in digital retail, including data analytics, social media marketing, and omnichannel retailing. This certificate is designed for individuals seeking to enhance their skills for career advancement or those who wish to transition into the fast-paced and evolving digital retail industry. The certificate can also be stacked to meet degree requirements for the Master of Science in Merchandising. A 3.0 GPA is required for all certificate courses. All courses must be completed within 6 years.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Digital Retail Merchandising

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Digital Social Science introduces graduate students to the skills necessary to conduct research and analyze digital social data using computational methods. The certificate emphasizes the interdisciplinary nature of digital social science, drawing on insights from computer science, statistics, and the social sciences. Students will gain practical experience with various computational tools and techniques, including data collection, data management, data analysis, and data visualization. Upon completion of the certificate, students will be equipped to analyze digital social data, interpret their findings, and communicate their results effectively.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Digital Social Science

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Digital Sociology provides advanced training in the theoretical and methodological approaches to understanding and analyzing the relationship between digital technologies and society. Students will gain critical skills in areas such as social media analysis, digital data collection and analysis, and the ethical implications of digital research. This interdisciplinary certificate is designed for graduate students and professionals seeking to enhance their expertise in digital sociology for academic, research, or professional careers.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Digital Sociology

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Dual Credit Teaching in Mathematics is offered through UNT Dallas, in the Department of Mathematics. It is designed to prepare current high school teachers to meet the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges (SACSCOC) 18 graduate credit hour requirement needed to teach dual credit courses in Mathematics at the high school level. Courses completed in this certificate will fulfill the 18-hour requirement.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Dual Credit Teaching in Mathematics

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Economic Geography provides graduate training in the spatial aspects of economic systems and development. Students will learn about topics such as economic globalization, regional development, sustainable development, consumption, and production systems and will gain skills in economic data analysis and visualization. The certificate is designed for students already enrolled in graduate programs at UNT (e.g., MS or PhD in Geography or other social sciences) as well as post-baccalaureate students in North Texas. Courses required for the certificate may count toward a Geography graduate degree.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Economic Geography

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Energy Accounting provides professional development for energy industry accountants and auditors to enhance their knowledge in the complex area of energy accounting. The certificate will address issues related to oil and gas, utilities, alternative energy and environmental accounting. The certificate consists of 12 graduate credit hours. Graduates of the program will be able to: Demonstrate an understanding of current financial accounting, auditing and taxation issues applicable to companies in the energy industry. Demonstrate knowledge of current issues in financial reporting as it applies to the energy industry. Demonstrate an understanding of internal controls and risk management issues in the energy industry. Demonstrate an understanding of ethical issues within the energy industry.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Energy Accounting

description: UNT's Department of Energy and Environmental Policy (ENEP) offers a Graduate Academic Certificate in Energy. Students interested in energy policy have a unique opportunity to gain knowledge and experience in energy issues and policy. The certificate can be standalone or complement another graduate degree. The certificate requires 12 credit hours (4 courses). The certificate program allows students to specialize in areas relating to energy, renewable energy, and fossil fuels. Students gain foundational knowledge and understanding of energy-related topics across multiple disciplines. Courses cover topics such as: U.S. and international energy policy, energy demand, energy economics, renewable energy, energy conservation, environmental issues, and energy security. The Graduate Academic Certificate in Energy provides students with the foundational knowledge and skills in current energy issues that are critical in today's energy landscape. These skills are highly valued by employers in both the private and public sector.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Energy

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Environmental Ethics and Science introduces students to the core philosophical concepts, theories and debates in environmental ethics, and provides students with basic training in environmental science. The Certificate integrates ethical theory, policy, and scientific method, and is designed to provide students with the interdisciplinary knowledge and skills needed for a variety of occupations that require both scientific literacy and ethical problem solving related to the environment. The Certificate serves a wide range of students including those working in federal or state government, NGOs, and the private sector; current or prospective graduate students who wish to add a credential in environmental ethics and science; and individuals who wish to pursue the Certificate as a stand-alone credential. The Certificate requires 15 credit hours of graduate course work (9 hours in philosophy courses and 6 hours in environmental science courses) and can be completed in approximately 1.5-2 years.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Environmental Ethics and Science

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Event Management provides comprehensive training and knowledge necessary to successfully plan, implement, and manage a wide range of events. This certificate is designed for professionals seeking to enhance their careers in the event planning industry, or for individuals looking to gain specialized knowledge in this growing field. The program emphasizes strategic planning, operational logistics, risk management, marketing, and sustainability in event contexts. Students will learn how to design, execute, and evaluate various types of events, including corporate meetings, conferences, festivals, and social gatherings. The curriculum also covers budgeting, vendor negotiations, sponsorship acquisition, and the application of technology in event management. Graduates will be equipped with the skills and expertise to pursue leadership roles in event management, hospitality, tourism, and related sectors.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Event Management

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Gender, Feminism, and Environmental Justice (GFEJ) is designed for students who want to develop skills and knowledge to engage in scholarly research, public policy, and advocacy that addresses the gendered and racialized dimensions of environmental problems and environmental movements. The certificate is housed in the Department of Women's and Gender Studies and is available to all graduate students at UNT as well as post-baccalaureate students not currently enrolled in a UNT graduate program. Students must apply for admission to the certificate program. Current graduate students who wish to add the certificate may do so by submitting a certificate application to the Toulouse Graduate School after completing at least 9 credit hours toward their graduate degree and having a minimum 3.0 graduate GPA. Non-degree seeking students may apply to the Toulouse Graduate School as post-baccalaureate students.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Gender, Feminism and Environmental Justice

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Geographic Information Systems (GIS) is designed for those who wish to enhance their skills in GIS science and technology. This certificate is beneficial for individuals currently in a graduate program who wish to strengthen their GIS skills, or for individuals not currently in a graduate program but desire to obtain graduate-level GIS skills for career enhancement. The certificate is offered through the School of Public Health. Students completing the certificate may be interested in pursuing careers in Public Health, Environmental Science, Urban Planning, Emergency Management, etc.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Geographic Information Systems (GIS)

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Health Data Science provides students with the foundational knowledge and skills necessary for working with health data, and for understanding and applying data science methods in the health domain. The courses cover essential topics in health data science, including health care data formats, privacy regulations, data analysis, machine learning applications, and ethical considerations. The program aims to prepare professionals for careers in health care analytics, research, and public health, equipping them to leverage data-driven insights to improve health outcomes and inform decision-making. Students will gain practical experience through projects and case studies, developing a portfolio of work relevant to the health data science field. The program is designed for individuals with a background in computer science, statistics, health sciences, or a related field, who wish to specialize in the growing area of health data science. The certificate is offered primarily online.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Health Data Science

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate (GAC) in Health Information is designed to provide health care professionals and individuals with a background in health care or information technology with an opportunity to acquire knowledge and skills to lead and manage the increasingly complex information technology landscape in health care organizations. The health information industry continues to expand as providers transition to digital medical records, and the health care system relies more heavily on data for decision making. These trends are fueling a demand for professionals with knowledge and skills in health information to fill a variety of roles within hospitals, medical practices, health insurance companies, public health agencies, and pharmaceutical companies. The certificate program will prepare professionals to fill roles in the areas of health informatics, health information technology, health information management, and public health informatics. The curriculum focuses on health information standards, health IT infrastructure, health data analytics, and information privacy, security, and ethics. The 15-hour certificate provides a solid foundation of knowledge and skills that can be completed as a standalone certificate or as part of the Master of Science in Information Science (MSIS) or other graduate degree programs at UNT. This certificate can be completed fully online.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Health Information

description:
The Graduate Academic Certificate in Health Services Administration will provide students with the knowledge and skills necessary to prepare them for leadership positions in various healthcare settings, including hospitals, clinics, nursing homes, and managed care organizations. The certificate focuses on the administrative aspects of healthcare, such as financial management, human resources, strategic planning, and quality improvement. The curriculum is designed for working professionals seeking to advance their careers in healthcare administration.

The program consists of 15 credit hours of graduate-level coursework. The curriculum includes courses in healthcare policy, financial management, strategic planning, and human resources. Students will also complete a capstone project or internship, allowing them to apply their knowledge and skills in a real-world healthcare setting.

Upon completion of the certificate, students will be prepared to assume leadership roles in various healthcare organizations. Graduates will have the skills and knowledge to manage complex healthcare organizations, lead teams, and make sound financial decisions. The certificate is also an excellent option for students interested in pursuing a master's degree in health services administration or a related field.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Health Services Administration

description: Our Graduate Academic Certificate (GAC) in Hospitality Management provides an opportunity for working professionals or those wishing to advance their career to gain additional knowledge and skills related to management in the hospitality and tourism industry. The program can be completed online or in a face-to-face format. This 12-hour certificate program is available to both degree-seeking and non-degree-seeking graduate students. All course credit hours earned in the GAC program may be applied towards a Master of Science (M.S.) in Hospitality Management degree at UNT, should the student choose to pursue a master’s degree in the future. The program provides the students with advanced knowledge and skills in hospitality management. Students will learn the key skills and knowledge needed to manage successful businesses in the hospitality industry while taking courses designed to provide a broad understanding of the operational and administrative aspects of the field. Emphasis will be placed on developing the skills needed for management-level positions, including financial management, marketing, human resources, and strategic planning. Why pursue a GAC in Hospitality Management? Prepare for leadership roles in the hospitality industry. Enhance your management and business skills related to hospitality. Open doors to career advancement. Deepen your understanding of current trends and challenges in the hospitality sector. Connect with a network of professionals and faculty experts.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Hospitality Management

description: The Instructional Design and Technology Graduate Academic Certificate (GAC) provides candidates with expertise in the principles and practices of instructional design, current and emerging educational technologies, and strategies for effective technology integration. Candidates will acquire skills in analysis, design, development, implementation, and evaluation (ADDIE) of instructional materials using innovative learning strategies and technologies. This GAC can be taken by itself or can be combined with other graduate programs at UNT.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Instructional Design and Technology

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Interactive and Virtual Digital Communication is an interdisciplinary 12-credit program designed to prepare students for careers in the rapidly growing fields of interactive and virtual reality (VR) digital communication. Students will gain practical skills and theoretical knowledge in areas such as user experience (UX) design, interactive media development, virtual reality content creation, and digital storytelling. The curriculum focuses on developing proficiency in industry-standard software and techniques, fostering creativity, and understanding the principles of effective digital communication across various platforms. The program is ideal for professionals seeking to enhance their skills, recent graduates looking to specialize, or individuals interested in pursuing advanced studies in digital communication.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Interactive and Virtual Digital Communication

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Learning Analytics provides students with knowledge and skills to understand how to collect, analyze, and report data related to learner and learning contexts in order to improve learning processes and outcomes. Learning Analytics is a growing area that has broad application in corporate, government, military, non-profit, and academic settings. The program is designed for graduate students and working professionals seeking to add expertise in learning analytics to their existing academic or professional skill sets. Students will learn the process of learning analytics from data collection to reporting, including data manipulation, visualization, statistical analysis, and ethical considerations. The program offers a core set of skills and competencies in learning analytics, but also allows students to customize their program of study to meet their own interests and career goals. The certificate is offered completely online.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Learning Analytics

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Learning Sciences is designed to help students better understand how humans learn across a variety of contexts and age groups. This certificate is designed for a variety of students, including those who wish to enhance their professional skills in learning and development within their current professional careers, those pursuing advanced graduate degrees in various fields related to learning, and those interested in pursuing additional knowledge within the learning sciences field. The Certificate in Learning Sciences does not lead to educator certification.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Learning Sciences

description: The Narrative Journalism Certificate is a 12-hour graduate academic certificate designed to prepare students to create compelling, in-depth non-fiction stories in both print and digital forms. The certificate is offered through the Mayborn School of Journalism and can be completed as a stand-alone certificate or in conjunction with a master’s degree in journalism. It is open to any graduate student at UNT. The certificate prepares students to work as journalists, editors, communications professionals or storytellers for a wide variety of outlets. Students will learn how to write feature stories, profiles, in-depth reports, and memoirs using journalistic reporting and research methods. Students will learn how to structure long-form narratives, how to gather information through interviews and observations, and how to effectively write for various media.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Narrative Journalism
Graduate Academic Certificate in Principal Leadership Preparation

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Program Leadership prepares individuals who are currently serving in leadership roles in the nonprofit sector, community-based organizations, and other agencies that provide programs or services to individuals and families, or those who aspire to such positions. This graduate certificate program focuses on building knowledge and skills relevant to the supervision, management, and evaluation of social, health, and human service programs. It is designed to be completed in one year and can be delivered in a hybrid or fully online format. The certificate curriculum includes three core courses and one elective for a total of 12 credit hours.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Program Leadership

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate (GAC) in Proposal Writing is an 18-credit hour program designed to help students develop the critical writing, research, and project management skills needed to effectively secure funding from government agencies, corporations, foundations, and other funding organizations. The certificate is offered through the Department of Technical Communication and is open to both degree-seeking and non-degree-seeking students. Students completing the certificate may be able to apply up to 12 credit hours toward a related master’s degree in technical communication.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Proposal Writing

description: The Public Relations graduate academic certificate program is designed for students seeking to deepen their knowledge in public relations or to add public relations skills to their existing graduate studies. Students will develop a strong foundation in public relations principles, research, strategy, and communication techniques across various platforms. The certificate also emphasizes the ethical responsibilities of public relations professionals and the evolving landscape of digital media.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Public Relations

description: This certificate is designed for graduate students who wish to develop expertise in qualitative research methods beyond their primary degree program requirements or for professionals who want to enhance their research skills. The certificate offers a structured curriculum that covers various qualitative approaches, data collection techniques, analysis methods, and ethical considerations. Participants will gain practical experience through hands-on projects and fieldwork, preparing them to conduct rigorous and impactful qualitative research in academic, professional, and community settings.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Qualitative Research

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate (GAC) in Rehabilitation Counseling advanced certificate is for master’s-level counseling graduates in any counseling specialization seeking to augment their knowledge and skills in rehabilitation counseling. This GAC allows individuals who have already completed a master’s in counseling or a related field (e.g., social work, psychology, human services) to obtain the didactic knowledge necessary to qualify to take the Certified Rehabilitation Counselor (CRC) exam. Enrollment in this GAC does not guarantee eligibility to take the CRC exam, as there are other eligibility requirements unrelated to academic preparation that applicants must meet in order to take the CRC exam. Enrollment in this GAC does not guarantee that individuals will be eligible to become a Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) in Texas; individuals who are interested in LPC licensure should refer to the Texas Behavioral Health Executive Council for more information on LPC licensure requirements.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Rehabilitation Counseling advanced certificate

description: A proposal for a new Graduate Academic Certificate in Robotics, Mechatronics and Automation was submitted by the College of Engineering. The proposed certificate addresses the need for engineers who are trained in developing new intelligent automated robotic systems. The 12-hour certificate will provide students with the opportunity to acquire foundational knowledge and skills in robotic systems, mechanical design, control, artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies related to industrial automation. The certificate will prepare professionals to meet the growing demands of modern industry with advanced knowledge and skills in intelligent automation and robotics, specifically focusing on the areas of Robotics, Mechatronics and Automation.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Robotics, Mechatronics and Automation

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Rural Library Management is offered by the Department of Information Science. The certificate is intended to provide practicing librarians and library staff working in rural libraries with the knowledge and skills necessary to manage the resources and provide services particular to a rural setting.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Rural Library Management

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Semiconductor Manufacturing Engineering is designed to provide students with the knowledge and skills necessary to pursue a career in the semiconductor manufacturing industry. The program covers topics such as semiconductor device physics, fabrication processes, characterization techniques, and packaging. Students will gain hands-on experience through laboratory work and projects, preparing them for the challenges of working in a dynamic and rapidly evolving industry. This certificate can be pursued as a stand-alone credential or as part of a master’s degree program in related engineering fields at UNT.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Semiconductor Manufacturing Engineering

description: The Specialist in Aging Graduate Academic Certificate is a 15-credit-hour program offered through the Department of Public Health in the College of Health and Public Service. The program is designed for students who already hold a master’s degree and wish to specialize in the field of gerontology or those who are currently seeking a master’s degree in a related field. Students completing the program will gain knowledge and skills relevant to working with older adults in a variety of settings. The certificate is offered primarily online. The College of Health and Public Service is accredited by the Council on Education for Public Health (CEPH).
Accreditation status: The College of Health and Public Service is accredited by the Council on Education for Public Health (CEPH).
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Specialist in Aging

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Storytelling provides foundational and advanced studies in the theory and practice of storytelling across different genres and media. Students learn to research, develop, produce and perform stories for specific audiences and purposes and across platforms including traditional performance venues, audio, film, television and digital media.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Storytelling

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Teaching English to Speakers of Other Languages (TESOL) provides advanced training in linguistics and applied linguistics to individuals who plan to teach English to non-native speakers of English in the U.S. and abroad. The certificate may be pursued alone or in conjunction with a Master of Arts or Ph.D. in Linguistics. Students can pursue the certificate as a stand-alone certificate, or combine the certificate with another graduate degree. The curriculum includes courses in linguistic theory, research methods, and applications of linguistics to language teaching. The Certificate in TESOL also includes a practicum component that provides hands-on teaching experience for students to apply their knowledge. Students in the program have opportunities to gain practical experience through supervised teaching assignments and internships, preparing them for diverse careers in ESL/EFL instruction, curriculum development, and language program administration.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Teaching English to Speakers of Other Languages

description: The Graduate Academic Certificate in Technical Writing prepares students for careers in technical communication and helps them improve their skills in the workplace. The certificate provides advanced instruction in the rhetorical principles and practices of designing, writing and editing professional documents for both print and digital delivery. It is an excellent credential for individuals working in professions that require strong communication skills, for students completing a graduate degree at UNT, or for professionals with undergraduate degrees who wish to gain graduate-level credentials in technical writing.
Program name: Graduate Academic Certificate in Technical Writing

description: This certificate is for students who have a master’s degree from an American Library Association (ALA) accredited program and wish to broaden or update their knowledge, specialize in an area not covered by their master’s degree, or to prepare for doctoral study. Students take 21 hours of graduate level courses from a personalized curriculum developed in consultation with a faculty advisor.
Program name: Certificate of Advanced Study in Library Science
